content:
# How to Generate a Random Man Page in [[Lunix]]
# dd if=/dev/sdX of=/tmp/dd_example/chunk.bin bs=512 count=1

## To clear or empty any log file, just issue the following command.

`$ cat /dev/null > app.log`

`$ ls -lh app.log`
